findings.summary: The free-shipping check compares cart.subtotal_cents() (cents) to FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (dollars, 50), so the threshold is effectively $0.50 and nearly all carts ship free.
Tests only cover an empty cart and a $120 cart, so they pass despite the bug; there is no test for a below-threshold cart (flat shipping) or a boundary test at exactly $50.00.
